notes.title: New Game is Released! 📣 Fight School Simulator is on Steam! 🥋
notes.notes:
Dear Assassins! 🗡️ My new game, Fight School Simulator 🥋 has just launched! Players are loving it, and it’s already scored an impressive [b]97/100[/b]. Dive into this action-packed journey of martial arts mastery and experience the thrill firsthand. 😊 Please play my game and support with your valuable review on Steam 🙏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769288/505297862bf730db01f54527e511a5c438420c47.jpg[/img]

Are you ready to become a legendary martial arts master? Build your own school, train your students, and battle rival schools to become the strongest. Join tournaments, raise your grasshoppers, and most importantly, collect tuition from your students!

Check it out on Steam now:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2884190/Fight_School_Simulator/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2884190/Fight_School_Simulator/[/url]
